result:
What a refreshing question!

If I could change the world in one way, I would make it so that every individual has access to clean, safe, and affordable drinking water, as well as adequate sanitation and hygiene facilities. This would involve a global effort to improve water infrastructure, management, and conservation, ensuring that everyone can live a healthy and dignified life.

Water scarcity and poor sanitation are pressing issues that affect millions of people worldwide, often disproportionately impacting the most vulnerable populations. By addressing these challenges, we could significantly reduce the incidence of water-borne diseases, improve public health, and promote socioeconomic development.

This change would have far-reaching benefits, from enhancing food security and supporting ecosystems to empowering communities and fostering economic growth. It would be a crucial step towards achieving a more equitable and sustainable world.
